A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AgentFlow/Flow-GRPO work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices A–F are readable and support comparison. The inconsistent new scaling discussion in v2 is an identifiable document issue, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, planner-training ablations, scaling experiments, tool-use analyses and qualitative case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains original benchmark results in Tables 1–3, scaling and tool-use experiments, and the seven appendix case studies.

M1.justification: The four-module architecture, evolving memory, planner-only training, trajectory-level rewards and Flow-GRPO objective remain unchanged, as does Algorithm 1. Edits to Wikipedia tool documentation do not establish an implemented procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use Search-R1 and DeepMath training data and the same ten evaluation benchmarks across search, agentic, mathematical and scientific reasoning. The additional scaling discussion names benchmarks already evaluated in v1.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–3, including the search/code baselines, AutoGen and alternative planner-training configurations. The Flow-GRPO versus ToRL training comparison is also retained.

E3.justification: The reported evaluation drops the calling-error-rate diagnostic across training steps shown in v1 Figure 6. Matched experiments retain their splits, sampling, accuracy scoring, judging and budgets. Appendix D.2 describes additional backbone comparisons, but its duplicated figure does not corroborate those tests.

E4.justification: v2 removes the quantitative tool-calling reliability analysis from v1 Section 4.3/Figure 6. Other ablations and case studies remain. A new D.2 paragraph claims scaling analysis on GameOf24, AMC23 and MedQA, but Figure 12 repeats the existing four-task analysis instead.

E5.justification: Both versions state that experiments use three trials, and both evaluation appendices mention averages with standard deviations. The revision adds no seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests or changed uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 have identical numerical entries. v2 removes the error-rate trajectories and reported reductions in v1 Figure 6, including 28.4% on GAIA and 19.4% on 2Wiki. The new scaling paragraph supplies no corresponding new numerical results; Figure 12 duplicates retained results.

T1.justification: Appendix B.3 substantially strengthens the convergence assertion. v1 explicitly says clipping offers no strict guarantee and presents empirical near-monotonicity in Equation 19. v2 replaces this with a strict monotonic inequality and guaranteed convergence to a locally optimal policy, without adding supporting assumptions or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central contributions: the modular agentic framework, in-the-flow planner optimization, Flow-GRPO and cross-domain superiority with a 7B backbone. Claims of improved tool-calling reliability remain despite removal of the quantitative diagnostic.

C2.justification: v2 removes the interpretation that declining calling errors demonstrate learning correct arguments and formats, and deletes the Wikipedia page-filtering limitation. Appendix B.3 removes the qualification on strict guarantees, while D.2 extends the scaling interpretation to three benchmarks unsupported by its accompanying figure.

D1.justification: Appendix E.2.4 removes documentation about LLM-based page selection and its associated warning. The embedding-based retrieval description remains unchanged. Training hyperparameters and hardware information move from Section 4.1 to Appendix C.1; this is relocation, not newly disclosed settings. Resource links remain equivalent.

R1.justification: The evaluation paragraph loses its explicit Lu et al. (2025) attribution when becoming Appendix C.2, reducing specificity about methodological provenance. That work remains cited elsewhere; the bibliography and broader positioning against monolithic models and static agentic systems are unchanged.

P1.justification: Experimental subsections are reordered, training details move into Appendix C.1, and the technical-contribution summary box and concluding future-work sentence are removed. Author, acknowledgment and conference-header text receive small edits. Most prose and the overall section structure are retained.

P2.justification: The experimental displays are substantially rearranged and resized. v1 Figure 10 is separated into v2 Figure 7 and Table 4; the calling-error plot is removed; a duplicate scaling plot becomes Figure 12. Appendix module prompts receive separate pages instead of spanning shared pages, materially changing their presentation.

improvement.justification: The core method and benchmark results remain intact, but v2 weakens rigor and evidential consistency: Appendix B.3 asserts a strict guarantee without a stronger derivation, Figure 12 does not support its new scaling discussion, and quantitative calling-error evidence disappears while reliability claims remain. Clearer prompt pagination and experimental reorganization do not offset these localized losses.
